summary: Southern Copper Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of $1.25 billion 5.350% senior unsecured notes due 2036 in an underwritten registered public offering. The offering is expected to close on June 24, 2026. Proceeds will fund the Tia Maria project, capital expenditures, and general corporate purposes through its Peruvian branch. BofA Securities and Morgan Stanley acted as global coordinators and joint bookrunners. This is a straight debt issuance, not a special situation; watch for use-of-proceeds execution risk and copper price sensitivity.
